scenes.stage_direction: The search becomes a confrontation with named decision-makers. Each signed record changes a concrete next step.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Did he look at them when they spoke?

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: They confirm he is alive and receiving care. They will give you the details directly.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Then why can't I go to him? What is stopping us now?

metadata.evidence_summary: Ethan is confirmed alive and receiving care.
